Legal.privacyPlaceholderNote: This policy contains standard text compliant with GDPR (EU Regulation 2016/679), but the data controller's identifying details are placeholders. They must be completed with company name, VAT number, registered address and email before publishing this page.

privacySections.title: 1. Data controller
privacySections.body: The data controller's identifying details are shown at the top of this page. For any request regarding the processing of your personal data, you can write to g.f.hub0@gmail.com.

privacySections.title: 2. Data we collect
privacySections.body: While browsing and using the site, we collect: data you provide voluntarily during registration or purchase (name, email, shipping address, phone number); data related to your orders and purchase history; technical browsing data (IP, browser, pages visited); payment data, handled directly by Stripe, which we do not store.

privacySections.title: 3. Purpose and legal basis of processing
privacySections.body: Your data is processed to: manage and fulfill orders and communicate shipping status (performance of a contract); manage your account, wishlist and loyalty program (performance of a contract); handle returns and customer support (performance of a contract / legitimate interest); comply with legal and tax obligations (legal obligation).

privacySections.title: 4. Data retention
privacySections.body: Order-related data is kept for as long as required to comply with Italian tax and accounting obligations. Account data remains active until you request its deletion.

privacySections.title: 5. Sharing data with third parties
privacySections.body: Your data may be shared with third-party providers strictly necessary to deliver the service: payment processor (Stripe), shipping carrier, transactional email provider (Resend), in compliance with applicable law.

privacySections.title: 6. Your rights
privacySections.body: You have the right to: access your data and obtain a copy; request its correction; request its deletion, subject to legal retention obligations; object to processing or request its restriction; request data portability; file a complaint with the data protection authority. To exercise these rights, write to g.f.hub0@gmail.com.

privacySections.title: 7. Cookies
privacySections.body: The site uses technical cookies necessary for its operation (authentication, cart) and third-party cookies related to payment services. No advertising profiling cookies are used beyond those that may be configured through analytics tools, for which explicit consent will be requested where required.

privacySections.title: 8. Changes to this policy
privacySections.body: This policy may be updated periodically. The last update date is shown at the top of the page.

Legal.terminiPlaceholderNote: Standard text compliant with the Italian Consumer Code (Legislative Decree 206/2005). The seller's identifying details are placeholders and must be completed before publishing this page.
Legal.terminiSeller: The seller's identifying details are shown at the top of this page (hereinafter "G&F Hub"). Contact: g.f.hub0@gmail.com — +39 351 857 1990.

terminiSections.title: 2. Formation of the contract
terminiSections.body: Displaying products on the site constitutes an invitation to treat, not a public offer. An order placed by the customer constitutes a purchase proposal, considered accepted once payment is confirmed through our provider, Stripe.

terminiSections.title: 3. Prices and payment
terminiSections.body: All prices shown on the site are in Euro (€) and include VAT, excluding any shipping costs shown separately at checkout. Payments are securely processed via Stripe using the methods available at checkout.

terminiSections.title: 4. Shipping
terminiSections.body: Shipping terms, delivery times and related costs are listed on the dedicated Shipping page.

terminiSections.title: 5. Right of withdrawal
terminiSections.body: Under articles 52-59 of the Italian Consumer Code, consumers have the right to withdraw from the contract without giving any reason within 14 days of receiving the product. To exercise this right, use the form available on the Returns page. The product must be returned unused, intact and in its original packaging. The refund will be issued using the same payment method used for the purchase, within 14 days of receiving the return.

terminiSections.title: 6. Legal warranty of conformity
terminiSections.body: All products sold are covered by the 24-month legal warranty of conformity provided under articles 128-135 of the Italian Consumer Code, valid for conformity defects existing at the time of delivery.

terminiSections.title: 7. Limitation of liability
terminiSections.body: G&F Hub is not liable for delays or disruptions due to force majeure, nor for improper use of purchased products relative to their intended purpose.

terminiSections.title: 8. Governing law and jurisdiction
terminiSections.body: This contract is governed by Italian law. For disputes relating to contracts concluded with consumers, the competent court is that of the consumer's place of residence or domicile, if located in Italy.

ChiSiamo.heroText: G&F Hub was born from a simple idea: buying jewelry shouldn't mean paying for the name on the box, but for the material you wear. We work only with 925 silver and titanium, checked piece by piece, at a price that makes sense.
ChiSiamo.whyText1: The market is full of plated jewelry that tarnishes after a few weeks, sold at prices inflated by a brand name. We founded G&F Hub to flip that script: only real 925 silver and titanium, batch checks, and an honest price — without the luxury markup.
ChiSiamo.whyText2: We don't chase volume. We chase the right piece, for the right person, one they'll keep for years — not just a season.
ChiSiamo.value1Text: Every piece is individually checked before shipping. If it doesn't meet our standard, it doesn't reach you.
ChiSiamo.value2Text: No passing trends. We select pieces that will hold the same aesthetic value in five years as they do today.
ChiSiamo.value3Text: Direct communication, clear return and shipping policies, no hidden surprises in our terms of sale.
ChiSiamo.commitmentTitle: Every order, cared for down to the last step
ChiSiamo.commitmentText: From product inspection to packaging, all the way to delivery: we treat every shipment as if it were for ourselves. Because care doesn't end when payment is confirmed — that's where it begins.
ChiSiamo.teamMemberText: Brief description of their role and contribution to the project.
ChiSiamo.faq1A: Shipping times vary depending on the product and destination. You'll receive a confirmation email with tracking details as soon as your order ships.
ChiSiamo.faq2A: Yes, you can request a return within 14 days of delivery. You'll find all the details and terms on our dedicated returns page.
ChiSiamo.faq3Q: Are the products original and guaranteed?
ChiSiamo.faq3A: Every product is personally selected and verified before being put on sale, to guarantee its quality and authenticity.
ChiSiamo.faq4A: You can write to us anytime through the contact form on the site. We reply as soon as possible.
ChiSiamo.ctaText: Every piece tells the story of a careful selection. Come take a look.
